description: This file defines the StreamlyTheme composable function and a theme object for the Streamly TV application, applying color, typography, and dimensional tokens via Jetpack Compose.

classes.name: StreamlyTheme
classes.description: An object providing access to theme tokens (colors, typography, dimens) via composable properties.

methods.name: StreamlyTheme
methods.description: A composable function that applies theme tokens to its content scope.
